title: Market Metrics That Matter: U.S. Cash Equities September Volume Briefing
summary: Cboe Global Markets, a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.
body_markdown:
## September Macro Picture


- Total Consolidated Volume (TCV) averaged 16.9 billion shares in September, up slightly from August but down from June’s historical high of 23.3 billion shares.
- Decreased volatility and lower TCV, resulted in the continued shift to off-exchange trading, TRF representing 50.6% of Average Daily Volume (ADV) in September and averaging 50.4% over Q3.
- Retail cash equities trading in September remained lower, a decline that began in Q3 from its peak in May and June 2026.
- September closing auction volume increased 20% year-over-year, with outsized gains by NYSE.
- For discussion, is the decrease in on-exchange trading volume at the concerning level? When removing closing auctions, on exchange trading represented 44% of TCV up from a historic low in August of 43.6%


## Product update: Cboe EDGX Equities Exchange (EDGX) Retail Price Improvement (RPI)


- **Growing Participation:** EDGX RPI continues to build momentum, with seven distinct liquidity-providing firms actively submitting orders daily.
- **Pure Retail Interaction:** A non-displayed order type that interacts exclusively with incoming, retail-attested remove flow
- **Markout Quality:** Post-trade markout data highlights the benign nature of incoming retail remove orders, exhibiting zero adverse market impact and minimal price drift.
- **Low-Friction:** RPI Midpoint Peg offers an immediate entry point for participants seeking to isolate and trade against retail flow at the half-spread.
- **Strategy Synergy:** Existing participants actively leverage RPI to complement and optimize their broader hidden-ad and midpoint liquidity strategies.
- **Broad Market Breadth:** In September, retail-attested orders removed across 6,405 unique symbols daily, delivering deep, diversified symbol coverage.


[U.S. Equities: Retail Price Improvement | Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/markets/us/equities/trading/retail-price-improvement#edgx-retail-price-improvement)


## 23x5 U.S. Equities Trading on EDGX


- 23x5 U.S. equities trading is scheduled to go live December 6.
- Production testing began October 5.
- Member firms that are not self-clearing are required to have a clearing letter of guarantee signed by clearing firm.
- [Update - Cboe EDGX Equities Expands Trading Hours](https://www.cboe.com/notices/content/?id=61833)


## Quote Depletion Protection (QDP)


- Despite decreased volatility and market volumes, QDP on EDGX and EDGA remained strong, protecting members during times of quote instability.
- EDGA and EDGX grew 56.8% and 13.3% year-over-year.
- When QDP is activated on a Midpoint Discretionary Order (MDO), discretionary range is turned off, minimizing poor performance.
